tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The ground. The garden fills the screen with it. All text is checked against it.

tokens.name: deep-night
tokens.usage: Base of overlays. Always used through overlay-fill at 80% with a 16px backdrop blur, never solid.

tokens.name: overlay-fill
tokens.usage: Deep night at 80%: the fill of every overlay, with backdrop-filter blur(16px).

tokens.name: overlay-border
tokens.usage: White at 8%: the 1px border of every overlay.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Fog itself, faded flowers, and secondary and interface text. 6.3:1 on night, 5.9:1 on an overlay. Every flower colour blends toward it as a memory fades.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Memory text and anything the person must read first. 15.5:1 on night, 14.6:1 on an overlay.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Threads of light between memories. Brighter (more opaque, wider glow) means a stronger connection.

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: Light, the tending currency: lit dots in the light counter, and the warm centre of a vivid flower.

tokens.name: sentence
tokens.usage: Sentence flowers: pale gold, a tall single stem with a few long petals. Vivid state.

tokens.name: song
tokens.usage: Song flowers: violet, a spiral stem with a bell-shaped head. Vivid state.

tokens.name: place
tokens.usage: Place flowers: teal, a low cluster of many small petals. Vivid state.

tokens.name: sentence-fading
tokens.usage: Sentence colour in the fading state: half-blended toward fog (oklab).

tokens.name: song-fading
tokens.usage: Song colour in the fading state: half-blended toward fog (oklab).

tokens.name: place-fading
tokens.usage: Place colour in the fading state: half-blended toward fog (oklab).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 1.5px solid with a 3px offset on every focusable element.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Rare titles only: the name on the first-run screen. text-primary.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The title of an overlay, when it needs one. text-primary.

styles.name: memory-lg
styles.sample: The kitchen smelled of oranges the winter she taught me to dance.
styles.usage: A memory recalled in full beside its flower. text-primary.

styles.name: memory
styles.sample: Rain on the lake house roof, all night.
styles.usage: A memory in passing, on hover, and in the planting field as it is typed. text-primary.

styles.name: speech
styles.usage: Quoted speech inside a memory is italic, at the size of the memory around it. Recollection does this automatically.

styles.name: interface
styles.usage: Buttons, the planting field's kinds, whispers. Usually fog.

styles.name: interface-sm
styles.usage: Labels under a memory and beside the light counter. fog.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and the line it annotates.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between light dots; inside a pill button vertically.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between memory text and its labels, between a flower and its recollection, and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Overlay padding and the canvas safe margin for interface at the edges.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Clear ground around a recalled memory.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Minimum distance between two flower bases on the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: A photo memory's image inside a recollection or overlay.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.usage: Every overlay.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Outline pill buttons, light dots, and every point of light.

shadow.note: Light, never shadow: these are glows. Nothing in Lethe casts a dark shadow.

tokens.name: glow-text
tokens.usage: Text-shadow on recalled memory text.

tokens.name: glow-light
tokens.usage: A lit dot in the light counter.

opacity.note: Interface appears only when needed. Flowers fade by colour first, then by opacity in the ghost and lost states.

tokens.name: ui-asleep
tokens.usage: Edge chrome (light counter, planting field) after 4s without pointer movement.

tokens.name: ui-idle
tokens.usage: Edge chrome while the pointer moves elsewhere. Wakes to 1 on hover or focus.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: Stroke opacity of a ghost flower's translucent outline.

tokens.name: fog-thin
tokens.usage: Fog banks (fog colour, blur 60px or more) over the open garden.

tokens.name: fog-thick
tokens.usage: Fog banks in front of ghost and lost memories.
